how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-durotar-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

tokens.31: $GI see that look in your eyes, do not think I will tolerate any insolence. Thrall himself has declared the Hordes females to be on equal footing with you men. Disrespect me in the slightest, and you will know true pain.:I'm happy to have met you. Thrall will be glad to know that more females like you and I are taking the initiative to push forward in the Barrens.;

rows.quest:784:obj:0: Kill 10 Kul Tiras Sailors, 8 Kul Tiras Marines and ⟦E1⟧ and return to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.
rows.quest:784:details:0: Led by Admiral Proudmoore, the humans of Kul Tiras encroached on ⟦E2⟧, violating the Warchief's pact made with Jaina Proudmoore in order to defeat Archimonde years ago.
rows.quest:784:details:1: BThe human aggression was repelled and Tiragarde Keep fell. But recently, the Admiral's reserves, led by ⟦E1⟧, have retaken the keep and once again pose a threat to our homeland. These humans show no respect for diplomacy.
rows.quest:784:details:2: BProve your honor and travel south to Tiragarde Keep to eliminate the human invaders.
rows.quest:784:completion:0: Word of your bravery travels fast, ⟦1⟧. Tales of your victory at Tiragarde Keep will be heralded in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:786:obj:0: Lar Prowltusk outside of Sen'jin Village wants you to destroy the 3 sets of Attack Plans held within Kolkar Crag.
rows.quest:786:details:0: Lower your voice, ⟦2⟧. The Kolkar centaurs lie just over the ridge to the west in Kolkar Crag.
rows.quest:786:details:1: BLast night while they were raiding, I snuck into their village and discovered that the dirty beasts have a three-tiered attack planned on the trolls and orcs of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:786:details:2: BWe mustn't let their invasion come to fruition. Perhaps you can muster the might needed to infiltrate Kolkar Crag and destroy their attack plans.
rows.quest:786:details:3: BLast I saw, they had divided them up amongst three of their leaders.
rows.quest:786:completion:0: The ⟦E4⟧ would surely prevail if the Kolkar centaurs were to attack. But by preventing such an attack. we have spared our mighty warriors unnecessary bloodshed.
rows.quest:786:completion:1: BAnd as sure as there is sand in the ⟦E5⟧ desert, we know that there will be blood spilled before these trying times are through.
rows.quest:786:completion:2: BYou have served your people well, ⟦3⟧.
rows.quest:791:obj:0: Furl Scornbrow in the Razor Hill watchtower wants 8 Canvas Scraps.
rows.quest:791:details:0: Age has rendered me useless in battle. Now I make myself useful in other ways.
rows.quest:791:details:1: BFrom this vantage point I watch for invaders. As our strength here grows, I find myself blowing the signal horn less and less.
rows.quest:791:details:2: BTo pass the time I fashion goods to help younger, more able warriors defend our homeland.
rows.quest:791:details:3: BFor you, I can fashion you a bag for your belongings. If such an item would be of use to you, bring me some canvas, a material common to the humans and centaurs.
rows.quest:791:completion:0: Most excellent, ⟦4⟧. Any good ⟦5⟧ will surely find a use for this bag on the battlefield.
rows.quest:791:completion:1: BI salute your vigor and willingness to die in the name of the ⟦E4⟧!
rows.quest:806:obj:0: Bring Fizzle's ⟦E6⟧ to Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.
rows.quest:806:details:0: We cannot allow the Burning Blade a foothold in ⟦E2⟧! We must destroy them before their evil festers!
rows.quest:806:details:1: BI have undergone my own investigations and found that a Burning Blade warlock, the goblin Fizzle Darkstorm, has camped within Thunder Ridge to the northwest. There he and his cultist minions spread chaos.
rows.quest:806:details:2: BFind and defeat Fizzle, and bring me his dead claw!
rows.quest:806:completion:1: BYou do your clan proud, ⟦6⟧. And because of you, ⟦E2⟧ is free of one more agent of evil.
rows.quest:808:obj:0: Retrieve Minshina's skull from the circle of power on the Echo Isles.
rows.quest:808:obj:1: BBring it to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
rows.quest:808:details:0: I hear the voice of my brother, Minshina, calling to me in my dreams.
rows.quest:808:details:1: BHe was taken by Zalazane, the warlock on the Echo Isles to the east. And he is dead.
rows.quest:808:details:2: BBut death is not freedom for my brother. Minshina's spirit was trapped within his own skull by Zalazane's magics. In my dreams I see it with other skulls, in a circle of power on the largest Echo Isle. As long as it remains there my brother's soul is doomed.
rows.quest:808:details:3: BPlease, ⟦7⟧. Find the circle and retrieve Minshina's skull. Bring it to me.
rows.quest:808:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦8⟧. You have saved Minshina. You have saved my brother's spirit from slavery!
rows.quest:809:details:0: Since the last great war when the ⟦E8⟧ was defeated, I have searched for sources of demonic corruption in orc society. The collar you brought me confirms my fears.
rows.quest:809:details:1: BIt belongs to the Burning Blade, a cult that rallies around an item of demonic power. It is called the Demon Seed, and it resides in the ⟦E7⟧ atop ⟦E9⟧. It must be destroyed!
rows.quest:809:details:2: BGo to Far Watch Post, on the border of the ⟦E7⟧ to the west, and speak with my assistant, Ak'Zeloth. He will direct you further.
rows.quest:809:completion:0: Neeru wants the Demon Seed destroyed, does he? Strange...
rows.quest:809:completion:1: BVery well. If he wishes the seed gone, then I will tell you how to remove it.
rows.quest:812:obj:0: Find Kor'ghan in ⟦E3⟧ and get the Venomtail Antidote. Then bring the antidote to Rhinag near the northwestern border of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:812:details:0: ⟦9⟧... your timing is perfect. I just hope I can compliment your haste as well.
rows.quest:812:details:1: BI was careless while fighting a few of the venomtails nearby, and one of them stung me deeply. I can feel its poison weakening me even as we speak. At this rate, I got maybe an hour left to live. But I'll need your help if I'm to do so...
rows.quest:812:details:2: BKor'ghan in ⟦E3⟧ knows how to make the antidote. Find him... and hurry, ⟦10⟧. I won't be able to last much longer. He should be in the Cleft of Shadow.
rows.quest:812:completion:0: ⟦11⟧, you've saved my life. Thank you.
rows.quest:812:completion:1: BPlease take this; I hope it can at least help you in your travels, if not bring you some coin. From what you say, I won't be usin' it anytime soon. Kor'ghan is gonna march me through more of his rituals until I prove myself. More killin' boars, more gatherin' scorpid tails... ⟦12⟧
rows.quest:815:obj:0: Bring 3 Taillasher Eggs to Cook Torka in Razor Hill.
rows.quest:815:details:0: Bah! I almost forgot I need to get breakfast ready.
rows.quest:815:details:1: B⟦13⟧, get yourself movin' and get me some taillasher eggs. I'll need at least three of them if I'm going to have enough for tomorrow's meal.
rows.quest:815:details:2: BThe Bloodtalon taillashers can be fierce, and protect their eggs to the death more often than not. They sometimes bury their eggs too deep in the earth to uncover safely, but if you head to the Echo Isles to the southeast of Sen'jin Village, you can usually find them all over those islands.
rows.quest:815:completion:0: You might be weak, but at least you're not clumsy, ⟦14⟧.
rows.quest:815:completion:1: BHere, take this and get outta my way. I've got cooking to do.
rows.quest:816:obj:0: Bring a sign of Kron's fate to Misha ⟦E10⟧'kren at the farmstead northwest of Razor Hill.
rows.quest:816:details:0: ⟦15⟧, please, can you help me? My son Kron went hunting days ago, and he still hasn't returned. He went west towards the ⟦E7⟧ to hunt crocolisks along Southfury River. I fear the worst.
rows.quest:816:details:1: BAs strong as he was, his stubborn pride has always drawn him into trouble. I warned him that the crocolisks were powerful and vicious. He grew angry and stormed off.
rows.quest:816:details:2: BIf you can't find him, at least bring me a sign of his fate... even if you have to open up the stomach of every crocolisk along the Southfury's banks.
rows.quest:816:completion:0: Oh, my son... my beautiful son.
rows.quest:816:completion:1: BUncertain of my son's fate, I have tormented myself since he left. Now that I know what's happened, perhaps I can finally begin to mourn.
rows.quest:816:completion:2: BThank you, ⟦16⟧. Please take this. I was going to give it to Kron as a gift when he returned successful. Now that I know he is dead, I cannot bear to look at it.
rows.quest:817:obj:0: Bring 4 ⟦E2⟧ Tiger Furs to Vel'rin Fang in Sen'jin Village.
rows.quest:817:details:0: Many of the hides we use come from ⟦E2⟧ tigers, ⟦17⟧. Blankets, armor, tents: there are a great many reasons we hunt the beasts, and many reasons we let them thrive at the same time.
rows.quest:817:details:1: BThe time has come for us to cull the flock, so to speak. Our numbers grow, and our needs are beginning to overwhelm our stocks. I need more hides if I'm to prepare suitable goods for our people.
rows.quest:817:details:2: BBring me 4 ⟦E2⟧ tiger furs, and I shall reward you. You can find them on the islands south of here.
rows.quest:817:completion:0: I am pleased, ⟦18⟧. Because of your help, our people will be protected, and not go cold as the seasons change.
rows.quest:818:obj:0: Bring 4 Intact Makrura Eyes and 8 vials of Crawler Mucus to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
rows.quest:818:details:0: Although my eyes fail me, I still can see clearly enough. More often I must rely on my alchemical skills to aid me in magics that once came easily. But I refuse to take on an apprentice--no troll or orc worthy enough has ever come forward.
rows.quest:818:details:1: BAre you worthy? Yes, of course you are... of course you think you are.
rows.quest:818:details:2: BI need a few things. Will you get them for me?
rows.quest:818:details:3: BI need intact makrura eyes, and vials of crawler mucus. You can find them on any makrura or crawler in ⟦E2⟧. We shall speak again soon.
rows.quest:818:completion:0: Well done, young one... well done indeed.
rows.quest:823:obj:0: Speak with Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.
rows.quest:823:details:0: We at Sen'jin Village are not without our own troubles, and we thank you for your aid. But the news you bring regarding the Burning Blade could be trouble for everyone.
rows.quest:823:details:1: BThere is an orc stationed at Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar, who polices ⟦E2⟧ from evils such as the Burning Blade! Go to Orgnil and tell him of our plight, as well as your news from the Valley of Trials. He will want to know these things.
rows.quest:823:details:2: BRazor Hill lies to the north.
rows.quest:823:completion:0: Yes? You have something to report? Well then, let's have it!
rows.quest:825:obj:0: Gar'Thok of Razor Hill wants you to retrieve 3 Gnomish Tools from the wreckage off the coast.
rows.quest:825:details:0: One of my most observant scouts brings back word that the wreckage of Proudmoore's fleet still remains off the coast of ⟦E2⟧, just east of Tiragarde Keep.
rows.quest:825:details:1: BIt is no secret that the humans, in alliance with those foul little creatures known as gnomes, have an advanced knowledge of mechanics. We must have a complete understanding of all our potential enemies. And our people will benefit from this new knowledge as well.
rows.quest:825:details:2: BSwim through the wreckage, ⟦19⟧, and retrieve for me the tools of the ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:825:completion:0: Your recovery mission was a success, ⟦20⟧. I will see to it that these tools get to ⟦E3⟧ with the next caravan.
rows.quest:826:obj:1: BKill 8 Voodoo Trolls and 8 Hexed Trolls.
rows.quest:826:details:0: The witchdoctor Zalazane dwells on the Echo Isles to the east. They are the isles we once called home.
rows.quest:826:details:1: BFrom there he sends his trolls to the mainland, to hex our people and drag more of them under his sway.
rows.quest:826:details:3: BDefeat Zalazane and his minions -- former ⟦E12⟧ trolls, now lost to us. Bring me his head and I will know his reign of evil is over.
rows.quest:826:completion:0: With Zalazane gone, our tribe can again sleep in peace.
rows.quest:826:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦21⟧. The ⟦E12⟧ tribe owes you much. If you suffer from an ailment, visit my assistant Bom'bay, behind me. His voodoo is strong...
rows.quest:827:obj:0: Gather Searing Collars from the cultists in Skull Rock.
rows.quest:827:obj:1: BBring them to Margoz at his camp.
rows.quest:827:details:0: ⟦22⟧. The Burning Blade has infested the cave east of ⟦E3⟧ known as Skull Rock. Inside that cave they perform vile rituals, and burn their own flesh with Searing Collars.
rows.quest:827:details:1: BBy wearing these collars, I believe the cultists attune themselves to demonic power. But to confirm this, I must have a collection of the collars to study.
rows.quest:827:details:2: BGo to Skull Rock and gather Searing Collars from the cultists you find there. Bring them to me, and I will uncover their secrets.
rows.quest:827:completion:0: Good. Hiding within these collars is the secret behind the Burning Blade. And I will uncover that secret...
rows.quest:828:details:0: One of our Shamans, Margoz, knows more of the Burning Blade's corruption. He speaks of a cave called Skull Rock in the mountains - just outside ⟦E3⟧! - that shelters a large band of Burning Blade cultists.
rows.quest:828:details:1: BBefore you go to Skull Rock speak with Margoz. He is wise and his council is valued.
rows.quest:828:details:2: BHe is camped to the northeast, between the coast and Drygulch Ravine.
rows.quest:828:details:3: BFollow his advice, but whatever Margoz says, ⟦23⟧, I still want you to crush those cultists!
rows.quest:828:completion:0: Welcome, ⟦24⟧. Word reached me of your coming, and of your exploits in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:828:completion:1: BYou are a ⟦25⟧ of growing skill and renown.
rows.quest:828:completion:2: BStay on the pure path, and your future will be great indeed.
rows.quest:829:obj:0: Bring an Example Collar to Neeru Fireblade in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:829:details:0: The Searing Collars you brought me are powerful, demonic implements. Divining their origin is, I'm afraid, beyond my skills as a shaman. We will need a warlock to study them.
rows.quest:829:details:1: BTake a searing collar to Neeru Fireblade. Although he is a skilled warlock, he professes to use his powers to thwart demons, and claims his research in the occult is benign. Be that true or false, we may need his aid against the demonic cult in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:829:details:2: BYou may find Neeru in ⟦E3⟧ in the Cleft of Shadow.
rows.quest:829:completion:0: Ah, and where did you get this? Good Margoz in Razor Hill sent you to me, did he?
rows.quest:829:completion:1: BWell, let me take a closer look...
rows.quest:830:obj:0: Take Admiral Proudmoore's Orders to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.
rows.quest:830:details:0: You open the aged and weathered envelope and discover an official looking document. You recognize the seal of Admiral Proudmoore.
rows.quest:830:details:1: BThis looks important. Perhaps Gar'Thok, the commander of Razor Hill, would be interested in having this information.
rows.quest:830:completion:0: This does not bode well at all. You were wise to bring this information to my attention.
rows.quest:831:obj:0: Deliver Admiral Proudmoore's Orders to Nazgrel in Thrall's chamber in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:831:details:0: Humans cannot be trusted. We fought alongside them with a weary heart, knowing they would betray us one day.
rows.quest:831:details:1: BAdmiral Proudmoore's death was not enough to stop his legacy of deceit. The human scum had his plans well laid out before he ever met his demise.
rows.quest:831:details:2: BHis reign won't even die with Benedict it seems. Who knows how long it will be before the next waves of Proudmoore's men land upon our shores.
rows.quest:831:details:3: BWe need to get these orders to Nazgrel in ⟦E3⟧ immediately! He can be found in Thrall's chamber.
rows.quest:831:completion:0: Countless times I urged the Warchief not to trust the humans, but personal pride is not what is at stake here.
rows.quest:831:completion:1: BYou have served the ⟦E4⟧ honorably, young ⟦26⟧.
rows.quest:831:completion:2: BNow excuse me, I must counsel Thrall on these matters at once...
rows.quest:832:obj:0: Take this eye to Neeru Fireblade.
rows.quest:832:details:0: <Words emanate from the pendant and into your mind.>
rows.quest:832:details:3: BThere is word of your discovery in Skull Rock. You must prepare for an attack!
rows.quest:832:details:4: BGazz'uz, I order you to speak! Speak or I will make sure Neeru Fireblade knows of your presence, and he will descend on you with swift brutality.
rows.quest:832:details:5: BDo not test your skills against Neeru...
rows.quest:832:completion:1: BIntriguing. The voice you heard mentioned my name? I am known for hunting down enemies of our Warchief, but...it is strange that I was singled out. Stranger still that the Burning Blade cultists from whom you recovered this pendant have a name so close to my own.
rows.quest:832:completion:2: BI must study this pendant. I must study and, and must ponder the meaning of its message.
rows.quest:832:completion:3: BThank you for bringing this to my attention, ⟦27⟧. You have done your people a great service.
rows.quest:834:obj:0: Retrieve 5 Sacks of Supplies and return them to Rezlak near ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:834:details:0: I'm Rezlak, one of Gazlowe's boys. Boss sent me to help the orcs here in ⟦E2⟧. Things'd been going good except for the caravans. Can't manage to keep them safe! Makes my job a little harder, you know?
rows.quest:834:details:1: BThe last shipment--they promised it'd get through!--was snatched by the Dustwind harpies of...where was it...Razorwind Canyon?
rows.quest:834:details:2: BI gotta have those supplies or I'll never get anything done! Follow the big canyon to the south, you'll find the ravine cut right into the west and east sides of the walls.
rows.quest:834:completion:0: Hey, now isn't that just the thing! You've got our supplies back for us. That's great. I'll be able to get back to work just as soon as I can find someone to haul these sacks for me.
rows.quest:835:obj:0: Kill 12 Dustwind Savages and 8 Dustwind Storm Witches for Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
rows.quest:835:details:0: Gazlowe told me once, "Rezlak. There's one thing you need to know in life, and that's if you want something done well, do it yourself."
rows.quest:835:details:1: BI can't deal with losing all our caravans, so I'm just going to take matters into my own hands. Drygulch Ravine lies through the eastern part of Razorwind Canyon. If we kill all the harpies there, the routes will be safe.
rows.quest:835:details:2: BOf course, there was one other thing that Gazlowe taught me, and that's "You can get anything done for a price." So, going to help me out, ⟦28⟧?
rows.quest:835:completion:0: I think I can breathe easy now, knowing that the harpies won't be bothering our supply caravans anymore. And not one moment too soon, either. I hear I'm being sent some fun little toys with the next shipment!
rows.quest:835:completion:1: BYou're pretty good at what you do, ⟦29⟧, you ought to track down my boss in Ratchet. I'll bet he could find some work for you.
rows.quest:835:completion:2: BOh, and don't worry, I wouldn't forget to pay you for the service you provided me.
rows.quest:837:obj:0: Kill 4 Razormane Quilboars, 4 Razormane Scouts, 4 Razormane Dustrunners and 4 Razormane Battleguards for Gar'Thok at Razor Hill.
rows.quest:837:details:0: When we arrived, the Razormane quilboars possessed much of the land, and proved a thorn in our sides. Through our efforts we have driven out the largest part of their numbers, but still they remain well-fortified in some areas.
rows.quest:837:details:1: BIt has gone on long enough, however. For our own protection, we cannot allow the Razormane any hold in our lands. Their camps can be found to the west of here. Look for the brambles and you will find them. Today we drive them from ⟦E2⟧, tomorrow, perhaps from all of ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:837:completion:0: I will pass along word that the quilboars have been removed from their lairs, and that their structures may be set to fire. The removal of the Razormane from ⟦E2⟧ brings us closer to fully securing the borders of our new homeland.
rows.quest:840:obj:0: Follow the western road from Razor Hill to the ⟦E7⟧ over a bridge.
rows.quest:840:obj:1: BStop at the orc outpost across the bridge.
rows.quest:840:obj:2: BGive Kargal Battlescar at the ⟦E7⟧ outpost your recruitment letter.
rows.quest:840:details:1: BListen, my good friend Kargal needs some new recruits for ⟦E7⟧ duty. I know you want to do what's right for the ⟦E4⟧. Well, this is your chance.
rows.quest:840:details:2: BTake this recruitment letter to Kargal and see if he'll sign it.
rows.quest:840:completion:0: Oh, so Takrin sent you? He's an excellent scout, I'm not sure what I'd do without him.
rows.quest:840:completion:1: BI'll sign your recruitment letter, but what we really need is someone at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:842:obj:0: Follow the western road from Kargal's Far Watch Outpost.
rows.quest:842:obj:1: BAt the T intersection, turn left and follow the road south.
rows.quest:842:obj:2: BFind Sergra Darkthorn at the crossing of roads within the Crossroads.
rows.quest:842:details:0: Take this signed recruitment letter to the Crossroads.
rows.quest:842:details:1: BSergra Darkthorn, curse her hide, is in charge there. She's a nasty shaman who will talk your head in circles before she lets you do anything useful. Thrall is convinced she's something special, but I'm not so sure.
rows.quest:842:details:2: BYou'll just have to decide for yourself, pup...
rows.quest:842:completion:0: Alright, ⟦30⟧. You want to earn your keep with the ⟦E4⟧? Well there's plenty to do here, so listen close and do what you're told.
rows.quest:924:obj:0: Grab a Flawed Power Stone. Bring it to the Altar of ⟦E14⟧ before the stone expires, then return to Ak'Zeloth.
rows.quest:924:details:0: The Demon Seed is a powerful tool for the ⟦E8⟧. It rests in a cave on ⟦E9⟧, above a demonic altar of fire.
rows.quest:924:details:1: BI have prepared power stones that when placed near the Seed will disrupt its connection to the Legion.
rows.quest:924:details:2: BTake a stone from the table and bring it to the altar of fire atop ⟦E9⟧. ⟦E15⟧ west, then north when the road forks. The Peak will be to your left. The safest climb to the top is on its northern face.
rows.quest:924:details:3: BAnd hurry--the stone's power will consume itself in time.
rows.quest:924:completion:0: Your task is complete. You have destroyed the Demon Seed as Neeru bid. But this is not the end...
rows.quest:924:completion:1: BThe destruction of the Demon Seed sent waves of power through the ether, waves of staggering force. I felt them, and I am sure other beings did as well. Others who will wonder why their toy was broken...
rows.quest:924:completion:2: BBut regardless of future troubles, I have something for you. Neeru sent it as payment. And he bid me thank you.
rows.quest:2161:obj:0: Bring Ukor's Burden to ⟦E16⟧ Grosk in Razor Hill.
rows.quest:2161:details:0: Excuse me? Can you help me?
rows.quest:2161:details:1: BI have a load of food here. I walked along the road and braved scorpids and spiders and worse! I brought the food to the Valley of Trials because I thought they needed it and I like to help out. But they don't need any food! Now I have to take it back to Razor Hill and I'm afraid of all the beasts along the way...
rows.quest:2161:details:2: BCan you take it for me? I'm just a peon, but you're a hero. You fear nothing!
rows.quest:2161:details:3: BTake it to ⟦E16⟧ Grosk at the Razor Hill inn. Thank you!
rows.quest:2161:completion:0: Ah, this is the food Ukor brought to the Valley of Trials. Did they not need it? Well, I guess they like to starve you heroes in training. Builds spirit, they say!
rows.quest:2161:completion:1: BThank you for returning the food. I'll stick it back on the shelves... but here, let me offer you some refreshment first!
rows.quest:2161:completion:2: BAnd don't forget to rest here in the inn. You may be a brave ⟦32⟧ ready to take on the world, but if your energy is sapped you won't be doing yourself, or the ⟦E4⟧, much good.
